status: Real data baseline completed; quantum model not implemented by Role 2
source_license: CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo record); cite original LIDC-IDRI as well
unit: One supplied canonical NID=1 patch per included LIDC patient
target: Radiologist suspicion: 1–2 low (0), 4–5 high (1). NOT pathology-confirmed cancer.
limitations: Selected clear-rating cases; not representative of all nodules.
Expert-provided segmentations required, not automated diagnosis from arbitrary CT.
Stored intensities are preprocessed, not raw HU.
Voxel-grid size is not physical volume and can depend on resampling.
Prediction scores are not established calibrated clinical probabilities.
One validation split; confidence interval is conditional on this split.
8 alternate-scan identifiers excluded rather than guessing label mappings.
